label: g1152-1.2.d2-n7
_why: SEVEN CENTURIES OF THE CANON 1.2.d2 (§10.133, §10.134, canonised 2026-11-24 before its runs): g1152-canon12b (1.2.d1 in the debug numbering) + gold minting (every gold rung 500 a level, where the tiered gold mines of every earlier 1.2 book minted nothing from their main methods, F296; the gold explosives lines half of vanilla's). The user, 2026-11-24: "Go with n=7 on 1.2.d2." A fixed-n batch: every run plays to 1936. The first runs of this book.

_arms.canon: {kind: config, config: config/mod_config.1.2.d2.json} - THE CANON (sha256 102f924c6abf5155, tree twin f72917a24fd8c954), a verbatim copy in config/mod_config.json; nothing a build reads changed since de20dd30.

_comparison: The seven runs of 1.2.d2: the register against vanilla 1.15.2 (n=8, F274) beside g1152-canon12b (n=6, F293/F294; a different book, shown beside and not pooled); the ledger; gold minting and government income of the gold countries (F296's model); the hoard and the private share of construction points (F294); the technology census, misplaced capital, red flags, old rungs, the wall clock in clusters (directional: no alternating vanilla, §3.4).

_predictions.note: Written before run 1, from F293/F294's six runs of the book before (the only change is gold minting, 0.7-0.8% of world government income by F296's static model: under the spread of any two runs). Direction argued only for the gold countries.
_predictions.world_gdp: The seven-run median 0.88-1.05x vanilla 1.15.2 (canon12b 0.97x, runs 0.78-1.24); the per-run range at least 0.25 wide.
_predictions.gold_minting: World minting income from gold: about 0.75x vanilla's in 1935 (canon12b 0.27-0.30x), above vanilla's in 1840-1860; the gold countries' government income up (South Africa, Australia, Chile, Japan, Mexico), the world's by about 1%.
_predictions.barrier: Past in one to three of the seven (canon12b 2 of 6), Britain or the USA.
_predictions.depeasantation: Germany's U* far above its 20% aims in at least five of the seven; the world's 45-58% at the end in the median.
_predictions.prices: The industry-output aggregate's 1935 / 1900 at 0.80-0.90 in the median, above the 0.75 aim.
_predictions.military: No tech-era-5 military technology in any run.

_stop_rule: None: a fixed-n batch, every run plays to 1936.
_cost: 7 x 1836 -> 1936, about 2 h 45 min - 3 h 10 min each: about 19-21 hours (the canon12b batch of four took 11 h).
